datasets.name: Database A (General Knowledge)
datasets.verbatim: Here, Database A was established based on the UAV images of ground surface cracks and non-ground surface cracks collected at a landslide site in Guizhou, China. The readers are referred to Cheng et al. [11] for more detailed information on the establishment of Database A.

datasets.name: UAV-acquired imagery (DOM)
datasets.verbatim: the aircraft adopted in this survey was the Feima Intelligent Aerial Survey System D200, manufactured by Feima Robotics, Ltd. (http://www.feimarobotics.com/en/productDetailD200 (accessed on 1 January 2024)).

methods.name: Image-analysis-based landslide identification framework
methods.summary: A framework that integrates object-oriented image analysis for landslide boundary recognition and a RetinaNet-based deep transfer learning model for ground surface crack detection. The results from these two components are fused using Boolean operations to identify landslides with different levels of confidence.
methods.source: Zhan Cheng, Wenping Gong, et al.

availability.author_statement: The original contributions presented in this study are included in the article. Further inquiries can be directed to the corresponding author.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory (Database A) is referenced to a previous publication but not linked, and the custom code for the image-analysis framework is not available.
